posts.title: Docker Swarm is abandoned
posts.description: Docker Swarm is a simple alternative to Kubernetes for container orchestration, but I argue it’s no longer usable for real-world workloads.

posts.title: A code bug that most LLMs don't catch
posts.description: A few months ago I spotted a (critical) software bug that could produce loss of data in one of my projects. Suprisingly, most LLMs are unable to detect this bug.

posts.title: Using Snowflakes for database IDs
posts.description: A practical example of using Snowflake for database keys without a centralized service, with .NET and Entity Framework Core.
